# <span id="aanchor268"></span> Service Queues

Use the Service Queues screen to monitor services within FLOWCAL. The Service Queues screen provides details about meters, locations, or quality sources that have not rolled yet, source analyses that have not applied yet, locations that have not closed yet, and pending HCDP calculations.

You can also use the Service Queues screen to force a re-roll of data for meters, locations, or quality sources, either individually, in a location or list. The data to be rolled up can be for all of time or just for a certain date range.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Service Queues screen:

- Go to the Settings Manager, and select the **Service Queues** link within the **Services** group; or

- Click **Unrolled Data** in the Rollups Viewer.

  When you access the Service Queues screen from the Rollups Viewer, you will not be able to queue data for rolling; you will only be able to view data that has not been rolled yet.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 598;height: 426;" />

If a record in queue becomes postponed, select it and click the **Queue** button. If the record continues to be postponed, you could be running out of table space or there may be a data issue. In this case, contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="notelink">Customer Support</a>.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Service Queue Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following tabs are available on the Service Queues screen:

- **Queue Data** - Re-roll a list, location, meter, source, or source list for all of time or for a datetime range. Queue a location to be closed for a specific month. Queue meters for the batch matching service for all of time or for a datetime range.

- **Unrolled Meters** - View unrolled meters in the queue. You can also see any items that have been postponed, held, or ignored. The queue should remain empty until the next import process is run, and will populate during data processing such as imports and edits.

- **Unrolled Locations** - View unrolled locations in the queue.

- **Unrolled Source Analysis** - View unrolled source analysis data in the queue. If you have configured source analysis data to be rolled in the Gas Quality Source Editor or the Liquid Quality Source Editor, it will display in this window when it is queued to roll up, and then follow the same process as unrolled meters.

  This feature requires the **Source Analysis** module.

- **Unprocessed HCDP** - View source analysis data that does not have a calculated hydrocarbon dewpoint (HCDP). Any sources that have been set up to automatically calculate HCDP or cricondentherm will display in this window when records require recalculation.

  The HCDP service checks the queue for unprocessed records once per hour. This setting is not configurable.

- **Unprocessed Analysis Apply** - View source analysis data that has not been applied to assigned meters or locations. When a new source or online chromatograph record is imported or an existing one is edited, it will display here.

  This feature requires the **Source Analysis** module.

- **Location Close** - After meters and tickets are closed, any locations that the meter or ticket is a member of will display in this queue. Additionally, once a location is closed by the Location Close service, any parent locations will display here.

  This feature requires the **Monthly Close and Systems Balance** module.

- **Batch Matching** - As batches are imported for meters with the [Reconcile Batches](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Liquids%20Tab.md) option enabled, FLOWCAL will try to match each batch to a scheduled batch movement. (See: [Scheduled Batch Movement](../../Imports/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement.md))

  This feature requires the **Liquids** add-on.

- **Live Oil** - If a Live Oil meter has any Dead Oil or Flash Gas meters associated with it, the service will perform calculations or transformations on the Live Oil data and apply it to the child meters. (See: [Live Oil Info](Live%20Oil%20Tab.md))

  This feature requires the **Liquids** add-on and the **Live Oil Management** module.

- **Data Archive** - View meter and location records with pending archive/restore/purge operations.

</div>
